title: IMMEDIATE OPPORTUNITY | DATA ANALYST
description:
Role: Data Analyst / Excel Specialist
Working Pattern: 3 days per week

Location:Morecambe area
Contract: Initial 3 months, with potential to go permanent

Are you an Excel guru who loves working with data?

I'm recruiting for a Data Analyst to join a busy team. This role would suit someone who is highly skilled in Excel, confident manipulating large amounts of data and has excellent attention to detail.

What will you be doing?

  • Manipulating, formatting and organising data in Excel
  • Cleaning and restructuring large datasets
  • Working with data sequences and ensuring accuracy
  • Extracting, analysing and presenting information
  • Identifying errors and inconsistencies within data
  • Supporting the team with data management and reporting

What am I looking for?

  • Advanced Excel skills are essential!
  • Strong experience in data formatting and manipulation
  • Experience working with sequences and structured datasets
  • Confident using formulas, lookups and other advanced Excel functions
  • Excellent accuracy and attention to detail
  • Previous data analysis or data administration experience

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking for a 3-day working week with the potential to secure a permanent position!

If you're an Excel whizz and available for a new opportunity, I'd love to hear from you!
